description: Multi-connection download manager for Windows with video downloads, torrents, browser extensions, and download queues.
notes: The ZIP stores the application under a top-level Multron-Download-Manager directory; extract_dir flattens it into the Scoop version directory. Settings and the download list stay in the data folder beside the executable, and Scoop persists that folder.
The upstream repository uses a custom source-available EULA, not an OSI-approved open-source license. Its EULA permits sharing unchanged official packages free of charge.
The portable build updates itself in place. Its built-in updater may change files in the Scoop-managed version directory independently of scoop update.
WebView2 is required; the upstream documentation says it is normally present on Windows 10 and 11.
